description: Funnel analysis: track where users drop off across a sequence of events (e.g. page_view → signup → purchase). Returns per-step user counts, conversion rates, and average time between steps. The lookback is since (for example 30d, 90d, or an ISO date) or days (an integer from 1 to 365, mapped to since as Nd, the same window as analytics_overview). Omitted, the window is 30d. Do not send days and since unless they name the same window. Anonymous preview is limited to agentanalytics-demo synthetic read-only data; sign in for your own projects.

breakdown.description: Property key to segment by (e.g. 'variant', 'country'). Extracted from step 1 events.

conversion_window_hours.description: Max hours from step 1 to last step (default: 168 = 7 days)

days.description: Lookback in days. Mapped to since as Nd. Omit when since is set. Integer from 1 to 365.

since.description: Lookback period such as 30d, 90d, or an ISO date. Defaults to 30d when days is omitted.

steps.description: Funnel steps (2-8), each with an event name and optional filters

filters.description: Optional property filters for this step

name: analytics_funnel
